title: Fix Forecast — Interactive Remediation Impact Calculator
goal: Let operators see their projected risk score in real-time as they mark findings as fixed — a split-screen before/after view where checking off fixes instantly shows the impact on the risk score.
scope: Add a Fix Forecast view to the Problems Center (backlog-84) or as a tab in Reports + Dossier. Layout: (1) Left panel (NOW): current risk score as a large red number + severity bars + list of open findings with severity dot, name, and impact score. (2) Right panel (AFTER): a green projected score that live-updates as operator checks off fixes. Each checked finding: strikes through in the left panel, shows as resolved in the right. (3) Diff notes appear: 'Risk drops from 72 to 18', 'Below 30 threshold achieved', 'X findings resolved'. (4) The risk score uses the exposure score calculation from backlog-69 — deterministic, no AI call. (5) Checks are in-session only (not saved) — this is a planning tool, not a state change. Actual status changes go through the existing remediation workflow. (6) A 'Create Retest Plan' button at the bottom converts checked items into a batch retest plan (using existing backlog-37 retest planning). The cinema_mockup.html Fix Forecast tab is the visual reference.
generation_reason: The cinema_mockup.html Fix Forecast concept shows a split before/after remediation impact view. No competitor makes remediation impact interactive and immediate. This is the 'show me what happens if I fix X' answer that security managers ask every time they review a pentest report. It turns the risk score into a planning tool.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: In-session planning tool only. Checks do not save finding status changes — those go through existing remediation workflow. No new API calls for score calculation — derive from existing finding data in state. No AI calls.

success_criteria: Fix Forecast view accessible from Problems Center or Reports.
Left panel shows current score and open findings.
Right panel shows live-updating projected score as findings are checked.
Score animation plays on value change.
Checked findings strike through in left panel.
Checks are in-session only — no finding status changes.
Create Retest Plan converts checked items to batch retest.
